SELECT region, service, job, label_0, delta * (sampled + to_start + to_end) / sampled AS value FROM (SELECT region, service, job, label_0, last_v - first_v AS delta, first_v, last_t - first_t AS sampled, sampled / (n - 1) AS avg_step, if(first_t - (intDiv({{ end_time }}, 1) * 1 - 60) >= 1.1 * avg_step, avg_step / 2, first_t - (intDiv({{ end_time }}, 1) * 1 - 60)) AS to_start_clamped, if(delta > 0 AND first_v >= 0, least(to_start_clamped, sampled * first_v / delta), to_start_clamped) AS to_start, if(intDiv({{ end_time }}, 1) * 1 - last_t >= 1.1 * avg_step, avg_step / 2, intDiv({{ end_time }}, 1) * 1 - last_t) AS to_end FROM (SELECT region, service, job, label_0, argMin(value, ts) AS first_v, argMax(value, ts) AS last_v, toFloat64(min(ts)) AS first_t, toFloat64(max(ts)) AS last_t, count() AS n FROM data_total WHERE ts >= toDateTime64(intDiv({{ end_time }}, 1) * 1 - 60, 3) AND ts <= toDateTime64(intDiv({{ end_time }}, 1) * 1, 3) GROUP BY region, service, job, label_0 HAVING n >= 2)) ORDER BY value DESC, region, service, job, label_0 LIMIT 8 BY region, service

SELECT region, service, job, label_0, delta * (sampled + to_start + to_end) / sampled / 1200 AS value FROM (SELECT region, service, job, label_0, last_v - first_v AS delta, first_v, last_t - first_t AS sampled, sampled / (n - 1) AS avg_step, if(first_t - (intDiv({{ end_time }}, 30) * 30 - 1200) >= 1.1 * avg_step, avg_step / 2, first_t - (intDiv({{ end_time }}, 30) * 30 - 1200)) AS to_start_clamped, if(delta > 0 AND first_v >= 0, least(to_start_clamped, sampled * first_v / delta), to_start_clamped) AS to_start, if(intDiv({{ end_time }}, 30) * 30 - last_t >= 1.1 * avg_step, avg_step / 2, intDiv({{ end_time }}, 30) * 30 - last_t) AS to_end FROM (SELECT region, service, job, label_0, argMin(value, ts) AS first_v, argMax(value, ts) AS last_v, toFloat64(min(ts)) AS first_t, toFloat64(max(ts)) AS last_t, count() AS n FROM data_total WHERE ts >= toDateTime64(intDiv({{ end_time }}, 30) * 30 - 1200, 3) AND ts <= toDateTime64(intDiv({{ end_time }}, 30) * 30, 3) GROUP BY region, service, job, label_0 HAVING n >= 2)) ORDER BY value DESC, region, service, job, label_0 LIMIT 4 BY region
